name: Stem borer
standard_evaluation_system: IRRI/ICAR Standard Evaluation System for Rice (SES)
source_document: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.) & TNAU CPG

early.symptom_description: Scattered yellowing leaves with isolated dead heart shoots that pull out easily; minimal egg mass activity.

moderate.symptom_description: Reaches ETL; noticeable dead hearts across tillers and initial white earhead formation; larvae boring inside stem base.

severe.symptom_description: Widespread tiller death and prominent erect white panicles devoid of grain; substantial yield reduction underway.

severe_spreading.symptom_description: Catastrophic crop collapse; majority of tillers severed internally; complete panicle sterility across field.

name: Brown planthopper (BPH)
standard_evaluation_system: IRRI BPH Damage Scale & TNAU IPM
source_document: IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank & TNAU Agritech

early.symptom_description: Initial nymph colonization at base of tillers; slight yellowing of lowest older leaves; no lodging.

moderate.symptom_description: Reaches ETL; noticeable yellowing extending up tiller canopy; visible honeydew excretion and sooty mold at tiller base.

severe.symptom_description: Severe sap depletion; localized circular drying patches (early hopper burn); tillers wilting and becoming brittle.

severe_spreading.symptom_description: Widespread contiguous hopper burn patches spreading across field; crop collapse and complete plant drying.

name: Leaf folder
standard_evaluation_system: IRRI SES Scale for Leaf Folder & TNAU Guidelines

early.symptom_description: Isolated folded leaves with fine white scraped longitudinal streaks; plant growth largely unaffected.

moderate.cutoff_range: 6%-15% folded leaves (or 5%-10% damaged flag leaves at booting)
moderate.symptom_description: Reaches ETL; multiple folded leaves per hill; larvae actively scraping chlorophyll from inside rolls.

severe.symptom_description: Severe leaf rolling across canopy; significant photosynthesis reduction; white papery appearance on upper third of crop.

severe_spreading.symptom_description: Whitish scorched field appearance across entire parcel; extensive flag leaf destruction leading to grain unfilled chaffiness.

name: Green leafhopper (GLH)
source_document: ICAR Rice Production Manual — Green Leafhopper

early.symptom_description: Low adult activity; slight tip yellowing; no virus transmission symptoms detected.

moderate.symptom_description: Reaches ETL; active hopper jumping in canopy; margin chlorosis developing on middle leaves.

severe.symptom_description: Heavy sap drainage; widespread yellow-orange leaf discoloration; stunted tiller vigor.

severe_spreading.cutoff_range: >30 hoppers/hill or active Tungro epidemic spreading
severe_spreading.symptom_description: Complete leaf chlorosis or virulent Rice Tungro Virus spreading with pronounced stunting and sterile panicles.

name: Gall midge
standard_evaluation_system: TNAU / ICAR Gall Midge SES Scale
source_document: TNAU Gall Midge Management & ICAR Manual

early.symptom_description: Occasional silver shoots (onion galls) visible at tiller base; plant compensation still possible.

moderate.symptom_description: Reaches ETL; prominent silver shoots causing sterile tiller loss in 5-10% of shoots.

severe.symptom_description: Extensive tiller galling; high percentage of shoots unable to develop productive earheads.

severe_spreading.symptom_description: Massive tiller destruction across field; stunted bushy appearance of hills with severe yield collapse.

early.symptom_description: Minute silvery spots on upper leaf surfaces; mild inward rolling of leaf tips.

moderate.symptom_description: Reaches ETL; conspicuous needle-like leaf rolling; tips drying and yellowing.

severe.symptom_description: Extensive leaf curling and drying across seedling bed; scorched appearance of nursery.

severe_spreading.cutoff_range: Complete nursery seedling mortality or field-wide dry-out
severe_spreading.symptom_description: Death of nursery seedlings under moisture stress; complete loss of transplantable nursery stand.

name: Whorl maggot
source_document: TNAU Whorl Maggot Management in Rice

early.symptom_description: Small yellowish feeding streaks on newly expanded central leaves; seedling vigor unaffected.

moderate.symptom_description: Reaches ETL; ragged serrated leaf margins visible on multiple expanding leaves per hill.

severe.symptom_description: Conspicuous broken serrated leaf blades and distorted central whorls across the plot.

severe_spreading.cutoff_range: >30% damaged leaves with severe seedling stunting
severe_spreading.symptom_description: Severe plant stunting, delayed tillering, and general stand vigor reduction in flooded fields.

name: Earhead bug
source_document: ICAR Rice Insect Pest Management Manual

early.symptom_description: Isolated adult bugs feeding during morning hours; rare localized brownish puncture spots on glumes.

moderate.symptom_description: Reaches ETL; milky grains being pierced; foul odor noticeable upon entering field; brown spots on maturing grains.

severe.symptom_description: Numerous damaged, shriveled, partially filled grains with blackened feeding punctures; strong pungent odor.

severe_spreading.symptom_description: Massive grain loss; over 30% empty/chaffy erect panicles; severe economic devaluation of grain lot.

name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB)
source_document: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

early.symptom_description: Water-soaked translucent stripes along leaf margins; yellow-orange wavy margins on isolated upper leaves.

moderate.symptom_description: Lesions expanding along leaf blade with characteristic wavy margins and milky bacterial ooze beads on damp mornings.

severe.symptom_description: Lesions coalescing; blighting of upper leaves including flag leaf; early kresek (systemic wilting) on susceptible varieties.

severe_spreading.cutoff_range: >25%-50% leaf area affected or severe kresek phase
severe_spreading.symptom_description: Complete leaf drying, systemic kresek wilting of entire hills, premature crop lodging and severe unfilled grains.

name: Rice Blast
standard_evaluation_system: IRRI/ICAR SES Scale for Rice Blast
source_document: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

early.cutoff_range: <1%-5% leaf area with pinhead/small spindle lesions
early.symptom_description: Small brown specks or circular to spindle-shaped lesions (1-2 mm) with grey center on lower canopy leaves.

moderate.cutoff_range: 6%-10% leaf area with typical spindle-shaped lesions
moderate.symptom_description: Typical spindle-shaped lesions (0.5-1.5 cm) with grey/whitish centers and dark reddish-brown borders on middle leaves.

severe.cutoff_range: 11%-25% leaf area affected or initial neck blast
severe.symptom_description: Lesions coalescing causing leaf necrosis; blackish-brown lesion developing at panicle node/neck (early neck blast).

severe_spreading.cutoff_range: >25% leaf area affected or >10% rotten neck blast
severe_spreading.symptom_description: Complete leaf canopy burning; neck blast causing snapping of panicle base and complete chaffiness of earhead.

name: Sheath Blight
standard_evaluation_system: IRRI Relative Lesion Height (RLH) Index & SES
source_document: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.)

early.cutoff_range: RLH <= 20% (lesions restricted to lower sheaths near waterline)
early.symptom_description: Oval or greenish-grey water-soaked lesions on leaf sheaths just above the water level.

moderate.symptom_description: Lesions enlarging with irregular brownish borders and grey-white centers; spreading upward along tillers.

severe.symptom_description: Lesions coalescing and reaching the flag leaf sheath and collar; white sclerotia visible on lesions.

severe_spreading.cutoff_range: RLH > 60% (lesions spreading into flag leaf blade and panicle)
severe_spreading.symptom_description: Infection covering entire plant height including panicle; tillers rotting at base leading to severe lodging.

name: Rice Tungro Virus (RTV)
scientific_name: Rice Tungro Bacilliform Virus (RTBV) & Rice Tungro Spherical Virus (RTSV)
standard_evaluation_system: IRRI/ICAR SES Scale for Virus Diseases
source_document: Standard Evaluation System for Rice (5th Ed.) & TNAU CPG

early.symptom_description: Slight stunting; light yellow or pale green discoloration on youngest emerging leaves of isolated hills.

moderate.symptom_description: Marked stunting; vivid yellow to orange-yellow leaf discoloration starting from tips; reduced tillering.

severe.symptom_description: Severe plant stunting, rusty orange discoloration, delayed flowering, and partial emergence of sterile panicles.

severe_spreading.symptom_description: Field-wide epidemic; severe stunting with entire crop turning orange-yellow; total grain yield loss.

name: Rice False Smut
standard_evaluation_system: ICAR-IIRR False Smut Damage Rating Scale
source_document: ICAR Rice Pathology Compendium & TNAU CPG

early.symptom_description: Isolated grains on scattered panicles transformed into yellow-orange velvety smut balls.

moderate.cutoff_range: 2%-5% panicles with 3-5 smut balls per panicle
moderate.symptom_description: Smut balls enlarging, turning olive green and releasing powdery chlamydospores; mycotoxin contamination begins.

severe.symptom_description: Prominent greenish-black smut balls visible across canopy; adjacent healthy spikelets contaminated.

severe_spreading.symptom_description: Heavy smut contamination; total market rejection of harvested grain due to ustiloxin toxicity.

name: Rice Stem Rot
standard_evaluation_system: IRRI / TNAU Stem Rot Rating Scale
source_document: TNAU Crop Protection Guide & IRRI Knowledge Bank

early.symptom_description: Small blackish irregular lesions on outer leaf sheaths at water surface during late tillering.

moderate.symptom_description: Lesions penetrating culm; culm softening with black shiny sclerotial bodies inside hollow stem.

severe.symptom_description: Severe culm rot causing tillers to break and lodge near the base under panicle weight.

severe_spreading.symptom_description: Complete lodging of mature crop; severe panicle sterility and harvest loss.
